_A_TABLE_GROUP_SIMPLE_DESCRIPTION_: A component used for straightforward data presentation in a tabular format, without the inclusion of advanced features like sorting, filtering, or additional actions.
_A_TABLE_GROUP_SIMPLE_COLUMNS_GROUPED_DE: Columns with children get a common header above their sub-columns. :has-mobile="false" keeps the table view on small screens.
_A_TABLE_GROUP_SIMPLE_IS_SIMPLE_TABLE_DE: is-simple-table renders a native <table> without the toolbar and the extra features of ATable.
_A_TABLE_GROUP_SIMPLE_MOBILE_SLOTS_DESCR: On small screens each row is shown as a card. The slots rowMobilePrepend and rowMobileAppend add content at the start and the end of each card.
_A_TABLE_GROUP_SIMPLE_MOBILE_SLOTS_LABEL: Table with slots of the mobile view
